scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The cyclin D/CDK4/6–cyclin E/CDK2–RB–E2F model is a well-established and biologically coherent explanation for heterogeneous cell-cycle entry and Ki-67 abundance in breast cancer. The proposed association is slightly simplified because Ki-67 accumulation is chiefly a cell-cycle-state readout rather than necessarily a direct E2F-regulated endpoint.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: CCND1–CDK4/6, CCNE1–CDK2, RB1 phosphorylation, E2F activation, DREAM repression, and p27-mediated inhibition are integrated into a coherent transition from quiescence through G1/S to Ki-67-high proliferation. The transition from E2F-driven cell-cycle progression to Ki-67 accumulation remains state-level rather than specifying direct regulation, and the upstream source of mitogenic heterogeneity is not identified. No synthesis ceiling was applied because an explicit focus-to-target mechanism is provided and nearly all invoked contextual features contribute materially.
